diagnosis: userCollections is a mobx computed. If it is first evaluated before CollectionStore has set m_mapCollectionsFromStorage, it throws and mobx caches that exception; the cached error never clears, so LibraryUIStore init (forEach over it) fails and the Library renders black. On main the plugin's refreshSteam -> clearCounts -> clearCollectionCounts reads collectionStore.userCollections as soon as the tag list loads. With 0 tags nothing triggered it early; with Attila's 98 tags it fires during startup. 21ca2f9's startup fix (f43f5c3) avoids it, matching the error-free 21:56 start.
